Title: Dolphin Social Psych Science
========================================================


# Read in file and set up variables
```{r} 
library(lme4)
library(languageR)
require(boot)
setwd("/Users/jsulliv1/Desktop/UCSDProjects/AnalyzeWrite/Dolphin")
s = read.csv("Dolphin_Data_Simulation_1to100.csv",na.strings="na")
```

### Set up both participant and accuracy as binary
```{r}
s$Participant<-factor(s$Participant)
s$AccuracySim<-factor(s$AccuracySim) 
s$SimExp<-factor(s$SimExp) #treats the data as binary
```

### Set up data to separate by experiment (1 vs. 2) and to include only trials that were correct/incorrect
```{r}
exp1=subset(s,(s$TestType=="E1")) #find only the trials that were Exp. 1
exp1sub = subset(exp1, !is.na(AccuracySim)) #finds only the trials that were Exp. 1 and had been coded as correct/incorrect
exp2=subset(s,(s$TestType=="E2")) #find only the trials that were Exp. 1
exp2sub = subset(exp2,!is.na(AccuracySim)) #finds only the trials that were Exp. 2 and had been coded as correct/incorrect

exp1sub$AccNum = as.numeric(exp1sub$AccuracySim) - 1 
```
